cues: Tested classes can be reused and extended.
A bug can only be in the class that owns the data.
Objects mirror real things, so designs are easier to discuss.
New features often mean a new class, not edits everywhere.
And teams can split the work by class.
The costs: larger, slightly slower programs and more design time.
text: Why use objects? Tested classes can be reused and extended. Private data is safe. A bug can only be in the class that owns the data. Objects mirror real things, so designs are easier to discuss. New features often mean a new class, not edits everywhere. And teams can split the work by class. The costs: larger, slightly slower programs and more design time.
